description: This file generates an iCalendar (.ics) export for calendar activities and tasks from the vtiger CRM system, querying the database, constructing calendar components, and outputting the serialized calendar data.

classes.name: iCalendar_timezone
classes.description: Represents the timezone component in the iCalendar export.

classes.name: iCalendar
classes.description: Represents the overall iCalendar object containing multiple components.

classes.name: iCalendar_alarm
classes.description: Represents an alarm/reminder for a calendar event.

classes.name: iCalendar_todo
classes.description: Represents a to-do item in the calendar.

methods.name: assign_values
methods.description: Assigns values to calendar components from event data.

methods.name: add_component
methods.description: Adds a component (event, alarm, timezone, etc.) to the calendar.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes the entire calendar object into iCalendar format for output.
